environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway. The instance has a public IP and security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting, no WAF, no jitter injection. An attacker on the internet can send thousands of requests and measure response time deltas to progressively recover the HMAC signature byte-by-byte.

config.network_path: attacker -> internet -> IGW -> instance (single hop, <2ms RTT from same region)
